name: How To Survive the Initial Attack and Defeat the Enemy
description: You will face an opponent that attacks you. Survive the opening assault, then defeat the enemy in a real 1v1 showdown.
message:
Objective: Survive the initial attack and defeat the enemy.

Overview: You are facing a real 1v1 battle. Your opponent will attack you first, so you must hold out through the opening assault and then counterattack to win.

This is not a team fight or a tutorial battle -- it is a true duel.
